prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 20s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, waist-length braids natural black hair — wearing a skin-tight ivory silk micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully covering her, paired with an ivory silk scarf folded into the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and knotted in a small knot at the side of her bust right beside one breast, one end of the silk trailing long down her side and the other end cut short, fully opaque and covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below it, no other garment on her chest, her stomach fully visible below it. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark beside her navel. Pose: standing on the floor of the open gift box front-facing with her weight on one leg, both arms relaxed at her sides, chin lifted, looking straight at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of ivory silk, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, in ivory silk with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a polished white table in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic red gift box with its lid lifted off, a huge satin ribbon bow in glossy gold, gigantic crinkled pink tissue paper spilling over the edges, giant confetti pieces on the table, a softly blurred party room far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall standing inside the open gift box with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright warm party light with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous gift box, ribbon bow and tissue paper around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
